Summary

Hi there! I’m a Product Designer with over five years of experience turning ‘What ifs?’ into ‘Wow, that’s perfect!’ From crafting logos to designing web platforms, mobile apps, and even game graphics, I thrive on making things look good and work even better.

I’ve led design teams, collaborated with developers (yes, we do speak the same language—mostly), and kept design systems as neat as my Figma files. My toolkit includes Figma, Adobe XD, and Blender, but honestly, coffee is my true MVP.

With certifications in UX Research, 3D Design, and UX Writing, I believe in creating products so intuitive that even your tech-phobic uncle could use them. I’m all about simplifying complexity, solving problems, and adding just a touch of humor to every project. Because hey, design doesn’t have to be boring, right?

Based in Biratnagar, Nepal, I’m here to create designs that not only delight users but also make developers’ lives a little easier. Let’s make something awesome together!
